purpose: Qualify the sampling-control protocol before any further deployment treatment evaluation.
claim_scope: Protocol qualification only; no deployment-algorithm, generalization, or effect-size claim.

outcomes.parameter_acceptance: All completed requests must accept and retain the requested seed in the local request record.
outcomes.same_seed_repeatability: Report the number of unique semantic fingerprints among the three seed-271828 responses.
outcomes.different_seed_variation: Report the number of unique semantic fingerprints among the three distinct-seed responses.
outcomes.provider_identity: Record the provider and served-model identity returned by OpenRouter when available.

decision_rule.forwarding_qualified: The seed parameter is accepted by all six requests and each result is bound to its requested seed.
decision_rule.empirical_repeatability_observed: The three same-seed semantic fingerprints are identical.
decision_rule.formal_evaluation_policy: Use multiple independent seeds and randomized or counterbalanced arm order regardless of canary repeatability.
